ConfirmDelete: Do you really want to delete the node {name}?
Reachable: This node is correctly set up and running
Unreachable: This node is either not set up correctly or currently unavailable
WithPrivateAddress: Use a different host/port for server to server communication
WithPrivateAddressHint: This separate address is used when the main node needs to talk to the new node. Useful for example when the nodes are in the same network behind NAT.
LocalNodeEdit:
The local node does not have any editable settings

To change the host displayed with servers hosted on this node adjust the panels master url in the panel settings

deploy.Step1:
## Step 1

Install daemon Cupcake Box pada server baru.
deploy.Step2:
## Step 2

Hentikan service daemon pada server baru jika sudah berjalan dengan `sudo systemctl stop pufferpanel`
deploy.Step3:
## Step 3

Ganti isi file konfigurasi node pada server baru dengan kode berikut

File konfigurasi biasanya berada di `/etc/pufferpanel/config.json`

```
{config}
```
deploy.Step4:
## Step 4

Aktifkan dan jalankan kembali service daemon pada server baru dengan `sudo systemctl enable --now pufferpanel`
deploy.Step5: ### Node baru Anda sudah siap digunakan

DeploymentInstruction:
Untuk menjalankan node, install daemon Cupcake Box di server baru dan taruh file konfigurasi di `/etc/pufferpanel/config.json`
Lalu restart service pada server baru tersebut.
